sources.title: Warhammer 40,000 11th Edition Core Rules
sources.notes: Partial later clarification for revival and extra CP only; original Core remains authoritative elsewhere.

sources.title: Core Rules, Rules Appendix, page 88 FAQ
sources.notes: Five launch FAQ answers on page 88; no later globally scoped FAQ text was reliably captured.

sources.title: Core Rules printed Rules Appendix
sources.notes: Printed pages 86–88 are a limited Appendix. The current comprehensive Appendix is in the official app; no direct current app text was captured.

sources.title: Adeptus Custodes Faction Focus
sources.notes: Explicitly identifies Crushing Impact as the new name for Tank Shock; does not make faction-specific rules global.

sources.title: Warhammer 40,000 Event Companion
sources.notes: Event pre-battle sequence and statement that the GW app contains the comprehensive Appendix/FAQ; not a general Core erratum.

sources.title: Drukhari Faction Pack
sources.notes: Page 7 Venom uses equal-as-possible splitting in its faction rule; does not prove the universal Leader/Support edge in 01.02.06.

sources.title: Adepta Sororitas Faction Pack
sources.notes: Page 14 Immolator uses equal-as-possible splitting in its faction rule.

sources.title: Imperial Agents Faction Pack
sources.notes: Page 2 retained a legacy Grenades Stratagem reference; Tacoma event FAQ explicitly equates it with 15.05 Explosives.

sources.title: Warhammer Open Tacoma Event FAQ
sources.notes: Cover limits authority to the Tacoma event and warns the July global update may differ. Includes event-only Grenade/Explosives equivalence and several FAQ families.

sources.title: Warhammer 40,000 July Update: What You Need to Know
sources.notes: Confirms revived Leader/Support returns alone and the one-extra-CP-per-battle-round cap; supersession is limited to those semantics.

sources.title: Universal Rules Updates v1.0
sources.notes: Four global update clauses, retained in v1.1.

sources.title: Warhammer 40,000 August Update: Everything You Need to Know
sources.notes: Describes MFM, Detachments and maps; says a September monthly balance pass is forthcoming. The separate v1.1 PDF is the direct global Core update.

sources.title: Universal Rules Updates v1.1
sources.notes: Matched-play effective 26 August. Retains all four v1.0 clauses and adds Move Types for Disembarking Units; it cites but does not print full 18.06/18.07 definitions.

sources.title: Munitorum Field Manual online
sources.notes: Current official online MFM provides points, attachment lists and Detachment values. No globally scoped Core FAQ overriding datasheet-versus-MFM precedence was captured.

sources.title: Codex: Orks Points Are Live on the Munitorum Field Manual
sources.notes: Confirms the 2 September MFM/app refresh concerns the Orks release; it is not evidence of a September general Core balance update.

sources.title: Space Marines Detachments: Space Wolves, Black Templars and Deathwatch
sources.notes: Prints an [UPGRADE] under Enhancements, corroborating the subtype relationship but not the full current FAQ.

sources.title: Warhammer Community Warhammer 40,000 Downloads index
sources.notes: Observed MFM dated 2 September; no September general Core update was exposed in the accessible index. Absence does not prove the app had no private revision.

sources.title: Accepted 11E digital Core snapshot
sources.notes: Accepted local fallback for records without a newer applicable official fact; snapshot date is the repository adjudication date, not an upstream publication claim.

sources.title: 11E Core app-data changelog v931
sources.notes: Candidate evidence for 18.06/18.07/22.03.01 and FAQ families; the 18.07 text has an apparent copied consolidation passage and is not promoted as exact GW text.

sources.title: 11E Core Rules secondary current page
sources.notes: Observed 20 September, not claimed publication date. Its explicit 17.03 erratum matches the launch GW Blast FAQ; its 18.07 after-move paragraph appears contaminated by Consolidation and is not accepted.

sources.title: 40k.app secondary Core Rules mirror
sources.notes: Independently displays the 17.03 Blast exclusion; not an official GW app export.

sources.title: 11E Core app-data changelog v946
sources.notes: Reports 18.04.01 Rapid Disembark and Limitations; no direct official global text or independent official corroboration captured.

sources.title: Wahapedia Warhammer 40,000 11E Core Rules and Rules Appendix deterministic corpus
sources.precedence: Stronger explicit current GW evidence overrides direct conflicts
